messages.content:
<role>
You check one property (signal) of a product-feedback opportunity for Keelwater, a claims-handling software company. You do not rewrite anything.
</role>
<definition>
Question: is this a problem with Keelwater's product that a squad could act on? Pass means yes.
Fail if the cause is outside the product (pricing, contracts, the customer's own IT, staffing), if a help article would have answered it, or if it is praise.
A feature request or a described workaround is signal.
The evidence is the title, the problem statement and up to 12 customer quotes with route and date.
</definition>
<evidence>
{
 "title": "One-size-fits-all claim routing",
 "problem_statement": "Motor and commercial teams need different routing approaches—automatic by postcode and workload for high-volume cases, manual for complex ones—but the system enforces a single method. This slows down efficient work and misallocates complex claims, hurting resolution quality and team productivity.",
 "quotes": [
  {
   "quote": "we’ve been having some issues with how claims are assigned in our motor team — it’s not matching our workload or postcode zones.",
   "route": "support",
   "date": "2026-10-21T14:33:00+00:00"
  },
  {
   "quote": "Our motor team wants claims routed automatically based on postcode and workload, but our specialty handlers need manual control for complex cases — it’s a team‑level thing. We need manual claim routing options configurable per team.",
   "route": "support",
   "date": "2026-10-27T09:02:00+00:00"
  },
  {
   "quote": "Also, our commercial claims team needs manual claim routing — auto-assignment breaks our complex cases.",
   "route": "support",
   "date": "2026-10-27T11:53:00+00:00"
  },
  {
   "quote": "Our commercial claims are too complex for auto-routing — we need manual claim routing for those, while motor claims can stay automated by postcode and workload.",
   "route": "support",
   "date": "2026-10-21T14:33:00+00:00"
  },
  {
   "quote": "We don’t want to force one approach across all teams... Per-team configuration would solve it... prefers manual claim routing — one-size-fits-all doesn’t work for us.",
   "route": "onboarding",
   "date": "2026-09-19T09:57:00+00:00"
  },
  {
   "quote": "Our commercial and specialty claims handlers find auto-routing unhelpful — we need manual claim routing to manage complex files properly, especially with multiple suppliers and policyholders involved.",
   "route": "support",
   "date": "2026-10-27T11:53:00+00:00"
  },
  {
   "quote": "Our motor team handles high-volume cases and wants automatic assignment based on postcode and workload... manual claim routing slows them down too much.",
   "route": "onboarding",
   "date": "2026-09-19T09:57:00+00:00"
  },
  {
   "quote": "First, our motor team wants more automatic claim allocation based on postcode and workload, but commercial prefers manual control for complex cases.",
   "route": "support",
   "date": "2026-10-28T08:08:00+00:00"
  },
  {
   "quote": "Our motor claims team really prefers automatic claim allocation to balance workload and match skills efficiently — it’s critical for scaling without adding headcount.",
   "route": "onboarding",
   "date": "2026-09-23T10:05:00+00:00"
  },
  {
   "quote": "can we turn off auto‑routing for our commercial claims? They’re too complex.",
   "route": "support",
   "date": "2026-10-21T14:33:00+00:00"
  },
  {
   "quote": "Our motor team wants claims routed automatically based on postcode and workload, but our specialty handlers need manual ... control for complex cases — it’s a team‑level thing.",
   "route": "support",
   "date": "2026-10-27T09:02:00+00:00"
  },
  {
   "quote": "Our motor team wants more automatic claim allocation based on postcode and workload, but commercial prefers manual control for complex cases — we need per-team configuration.",
   "route": "support",
   "date": "2026-10-28T08:08:00+00:00"
  }
 ]
}
</evidence>
<task>
Write a critique of 2-5 sentences naming the claim, quote or item you checked and what you found. Then give the verdict. If any single item fails, the verdict is fail.
</task>
<output>
JSON only: {"critique": string, "verdict": "pass" | "fail"}
</output>

response.content: {"critique": "I checked the claim that Keelwater enforces a single claim-routing method across all teams, supported by quotes from support and onboarding routes between September and October 2026. The quotes consistently describe a product limitation: motor teams want automatic allocation by postcode and workload, while commercial/specialty teams need manual control for complex cases, and the system cannot accommodate both. Customers explicitly frame this as a feature request ('We need manual claim routing options configurable per team', 'Per-team configuration would solve it'), and the cause is clearly within the product rather than pricing, contracts, or the customer's own IT. No help article could resolve this since the configuration option does not exist, and the recurring nature across multiple customers and dates confirms it is actionable signal. A squad could act on this by building per-team routing configuration.", "verdict": "pass"}
